items.question: What is CloudHost247?
items.answer: CloudHost247 is a professional web hosting and cloud solutions provider offering secure, reliable, and high-performance hosting, domain registration, and managed IT services for individuals, businesses, and organizations worldwide.

items.question: What services do you offer?
items.answer:
We provide:

- Shared, VPS, and Dedicated Hosting
- Cloud Hosting Solutions
- Domain Registration and Management
- Website Security and SSL Certificates
- Managed Server Support
- Email Hosting
- Data Backup and Recovery Services

items.question: How do I create an account?
items.answer: Click [Create Account](/register), and follow the on-screen instructions. Once you complete the registration, you'll receive an email confirmation.

items.question: How can I pay for my services?
items.answer:
We accept multiple payment methods, including:

- Credit/Debit Cards
- PayPal
- Bank Transfers
- Cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, Ethereum where applicable)

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: Yes, we have a Refund Policy that applies to eligible services. Refund requests must be submitted within the specified refund period stated in our Refund Policy.

items.question: How do I cancel my account or services?
items.answer:
You can cancel your account by:

- Logging into your [Dashboard](/dashboard) and submitting a cancellation request
- Contacting our support team through the [Contact us](/contact)

items.question: How do I request data deletion?
items.answer: Refer to our Data Deletion Instructions. Send your account details through the [Contact us](/contact), and we'll process your request in accordance with our Data Protection Standards.

items.question: Do you keep my personal information safe?
items.answer: Absolutely. We follow strict Data Protection Standards that comply with GDPR, CCPA, and other regulations. Your data is encrypted, stored securely, and never sold to third parties.

items.question: Do you provide 24/7 customer support?
items.answer:
Yes, our support team is available 24/7/365 via:

- [Contact us](/contact)
- Live Chat (on our website)
- Support Tickets in the Client Area

items.question: How do I transfer my website to CloudHost247?
items.answer: We offer free migration assistance for most hosting plans. Simply [contact our support team](/contact) with your current hosting details, and we'll handle the transfer for you.

items.question: What happens if my website gets hacked?
items.answer: If your website is compromised, our security team can assist with malware removal, security patches, and restoration from backups (if backups are active on your account).

items.question: Where can I read your full policies?
items.answer: All our policies, including Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Refund Policy, Cookie Policy, and Data Protection Standards, are listed on our [Legal & Policy Center](/legal).
